text: Salvia documentation Salvia is a Shopify theme for wellness, supplement and daily-care brands that sell a focused range of products. It is built around routines: what to take in the morning, what in the evening, and what belongs together. This guide explains how to set up the theme and what each setting and section does. Before you edit code or install apps that change theme files, duplicate your theme in Online Store > Themes > … > Duplicate so you can always go back.

Set up your store # In Shopify admin, go to Online Store > Themes and add Salvia from the Shopify Theme Store. Click Customize to open the theme editor. Set up your menus in Content > Menus . The header uses your Main menu and the footer's Navigation blocks use the menus you choose. Menus can have three levels: nested links open in dropdowns or a mega menu on desktop and in the mobile menu. Add your logo in the Header section, your favicon in Theme settings > Favicon , and links to your accounts in Theme settings > Social media . Pick your colors in Theme settings > Colors . Salvia comes with color schemes for light, paper, sage and ink backgrounds; every section has a Color scheme setting. Replace the placeholder images and text in each section of the home page.

What makes Salvia different # Routine builder : a page where customers pick products for each moment of the day and add the whole routine to the cart at once. See Sections . Nutrition table and ingredient spotlight : show what's in each serving, with reference values and authorised claims. See Product content . Supply and purchase options : how long a pack lasts and its price per day, plus subscription plans from your subscription app. See Product pages . Shop the look : a lifestyle image with numbered dots that customers can add to the cart together. Product comparison : up to four products side by side, built from your product data and tags, with add to cart buttons. See Product pages .

What's in this guide # Theme settings : colors, fonts, layout, cart and navigation. Header and footer : logo, menus, mega menu, search, announcements and the footer. Sections : every section you can add to your pages. Product pages : blocks, media, variants, purchase options and supply. Product content : nutrition tables, ingredients and FAQs for each product. Collections and search : filters, sorting, quick view and search. Cart : the cart drawer, cart page and free shipping progress. Blog and pages : journal, pages, contact, 404, password and gift card pages. Languages and markets : selling in several countries and languages. Accessibility and performance , FAQ and Support .
Theme version # You can see your theme version in Online Store > Themes , under the theme name. Include it when you contact support.
Theme settings Open Customize > Theme settings (the gear icon) to change settings that apply to the whole store.

Colors # Salvia uses color schemes . Each scheme has a background, text, accent, surface (cards and panels), border and button colors. Every section has a Color scheme setting, so you can alternate light and dark bands down a page. Keep enough contrast between text and background: at least 4.5:1 for body text. On dark schemes the Surface color can be a slightly see-through light color; Salvia lays it over the scheme's own background. For a dark header, footer or password page, add a Logo for dark backgrounds in that section. Salvia uses it automatically when the scheme is dark.

Typography # Choose a heading font and a body font from Shopify's font library, and a Font size scale for each. Headings grow with the scale; long headings wrap and sections such as the slideshow grow taller to fit them.
Layout # Page width sets the widest the content gets, in rem (144 = 1440 px). On narrower screens the page always fills the width with comfortable side margins.
Animations # Reveal sections on scroll fades sections in as they come into view. It's turned off automatically for visitors who ask their device for reduced motion.
Social media # Add links to your accounts. Icons show in the announcement bar and footer when those sections have Show social media icons turned on. Empty links are hidden.
Quick view # The color scheme of the quick view window that opens from product cards.

Cart # Cart type : Drawer opens a side panel when a product is added; Page goes straight to the cart page. Free shipping threshold : the order total, in your store currency, that unlocks free shipping. The cart shows a progress bar towards it. Use the same amount as your free shipping rate in Settings > Shipping and delivery . 0 hides the bar.

Navigation # Show back to top button adds a round button that appears after one screen of scrolling, on the Right or Left . It stays out of the way of the product page's add to cart buttons, and hides while search, the menu, the cart drawer or a popup is open.
Header and footer The header and footer appear on every page. Edit them in the theme editor under Header and Footer in the left sidebar.

Announcement bar # Short messages above the header, each in its own Announcement block with optional link. Rotate announcements shows them one at a time ( Change every sets the speed); visitors can pause it. Turn on the country/region selector and social media icons here too.

Header # Logo image and Logo width . On phones the logo is a little smaller so the icons fit. Logo for dark backgrounds : used instead of the logo when the header's color scheme is dark. Sticky header keeps the header at the top while scrolling. Main menu : on desktop, links with children open a dropdown; links with grandchildren open a mega menu . In a mega menu, groups that link only to products show product images. Mega menu: group shown as pills picks one group (by position) to show as rounded buttons. Mega menu promo blocks add an image card to the mega menu of the link you choose. Highlighted link : type the exact title of a top-level link (for example Build your routine ) to show it in the accent color. Account menu : links shown in the account dropdown. If there isn't room for the whole menu, it wraps onto a second line instead of running under the logo. Below 990 px the menu moves into a slide-in drawer.

Search # The search icon opens predictive search. Before typing, it shows Popular searches , a few Collections and the first products of Products from collection . While typing, it suggests products, collections, articles and pages.

Mobile bottom bar # An optional bar fixed to the bottom of phone screens with home, shop, search, account and cart links. Add it from Add section in the footer group. Shop link sets where Shop goes, and Show labels shows the words under the icons. It hides while the sticky add to cart bar or a menu is open.

Footer # Newsletter block: an email signup. Subscribers are added to your customers with email marketing consent. Show Follow on Shop adds Shop's follow button when Shop Pay is on. Navigation blocks: a heading and a menu each. Hide one with the eye icon and the columns rearrange. Text block: free text, for example your address or opening hours. Logo, Logo for dark backgrounds , tagline, social icons, country/region selector, payment icons and policy links.

Icon band and social gallery # Icon band shows short promises such as free shipping or vegan formulas; Hide on hides it on the home page or product pages. Social gallery shows images that link to products or to your Instagram; Hide on home page avoids repeating home page photos.

Newsletter popup # A popup with an email signup that opens after Open after seconds. Closing it hides it for Hide after closing for days; subscribing hides it for good. Add a Discount code (create it in Discounts first) to show it after signup. It never opens on the cart or password page, or on top of the cart drawer. In the theme editor it opens while the section is selected.
Sections Add sections to any page with Add section in the theme editor. Drag sections to reorder them, and use the eye icon to hide one without deleting it.

Settings every section shares # Every section has a Color scheme and Top padding and Bottom padding (smaller on phones). Sections built from blocks show a dashed hint in the editor when all blocks are removed, and hide on the storefront when they have nothing to show.

Home page sections # Section Use it for Slideshow Up to five slides with an image (and optional mobile image) or video, eyebrow, heading, text and two buttons. Tabs under the slides show each slide's Tab label . Height on desktop is a minimum: the slideshow grows if the text needs more room. Turn on Use as the page's main heading (H1) on one slide when the page has no other H1. Rotate slides automatically and Time per image slide control autoplay; a video slide moves on when its video ends. Autoplay pauses on hover and keyboard focus, and visitors can pause it. Text box position puts the card on the left or right, and Accessible name is read by screen readers. Collection list Collection tiles with image and product count, in two to five columns. Featured products Products in tabs, one Tab block per collection, as a carousel or grid. Routine teaser Up to four "moments" (for example Morning, Evening) with an image, badge, text, product thumbnails and a link. Shop the look A lifestyle image with numbered dots, one Product block each. Place a dot with its position settings. Customers can tick products and add them all to the cart. Ingredient list Ingredient cards with an image, source, name and text. Testimonials Customer quotes, each with a name and the product it's about. Write real quotes only. Collapsible content A short FAQ with a heading, text and link beside it. Blog posts The latest articles from a blog, with date, first tag and reading time.

Content sections # Section Use it for Image with text An image beside an eyebrow, heading, text and button. Image with text overlay A wide image with a text box on top, left, center or right. Rich text A heading and text, optionally on a card. Quote One large quote with author and optional image. Call to action An image banner with a heading and two buttons. Callout A small band with an icon, heading, text and button. Icon columns, Info cards, Link cards Short points with icons; link cards each link somewhere. Steps Numbered steps, for example how ordering works. Rate cards Shipping rates or plans as cards with label, price and note. FAQ Numbered questions and answers beside a heading. FAQ with topics Questions grouped under Topic blocks, with a topic menu beside them when there are two or more topics. Image comparison A before/after slider with steps beside it, for example how a powder mixes. Set the Before label and After label , the slider's Starting position and the Image position on desktop . Ingredient index An A–Z list of ingredients with the products they're used in. Video An uploaded video or a YouTube/Vimeo link with a cover image and play button. Nothing loads until the video is played. See Video . Scrolling text Short lines with icons moving sideways in a band. See Scrolling text . Logo list Certifications, press or partner logos, or short text badges. See Logo list . Newsletter An email signup band with optional image and small print. See Newsletter . Product comparison Up to four products side by side. See Product pages . Store location An image, address, opening hours and a directions button. Nothing loads from Google until the button is clicked. Custom Liquid Code from apps or developers.

Routine sections # Salvia's routine page (template page.routine ) uses three sections: Routine header : the page title, intro and up to four short steps. Routine builder : one Moment block per time of day, each with its products. Customers tick products, see the total and add the whole routine to the cart. Products that need a selling plan link to their product page instead. Featured product : one product with price and buy buttons, built from blocks. To make a routine page: create a page in Online Store > Pages , choose the template page.routine , then add products to each moment in the theme editor.

Video # Upload a Video , or paste a link in Or a YouTube / Vimeo link (used when no video is uploaded). Cover image is shown until the video is played; without one, the video's own preview is used. The video and the YouTube or Vimeo player load only when the customer presses play. Video description is read by screen readers: describe what the video shows. Shape : the video's own shape, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1 or 9:16. The video stays within most of the screen height, so tall videos aren't cut off. Full page width shows it edge to edge, with no height limit. Optional eyebrow, heading and text above the video.

Scrolling text # One Text block per line, each with an optional Icon and Link . Time for one loop sets the speed (higher is slower) and Moves toward the direction. It pauses while the pointer is over it or a link in it has keyboard focus, and doesn't move at all for visitors who prefer reduced motion. Show pause button adds a button to stop it.

Logo list # One Logo block per item, with a Logo image , an Icon or just its Name as text. The name is also the image's alt text. Short quote or note under the logo, and an optional Link . Logos are shown in gray and get their colors on hover. Upload logos with a transparent background. Only show certifications, awards and press you really have, and link to the source where you can.

Newsletter # An email signup with eyebrow, heading, text, Small print (for example a link to your privacy policy) and an optional image beside it. Subscribers are added to your customers with email marketing consent and the tag newsletter . The success or error message shows only under the form that was sent, even when the footer has a signup too. Button label is read by screen readers; the button shows an arrow.
Product pages The Product information section is built from blocks. Drag them to change the order, or hide one with the eye icon.

Media gallery # Images, videos (uploaded or YouTube/Vimeo) and 3D models from the product's media. The first image is the main image on cards; a square, plain-background image works best. When a variant has its own image, choosing the variant shows it. Thumbnails show a play icon on videos; a video plays when its slide is shown and pauses when the customer moves on. On desktop the thumbnails sit in a column beside the main image, with up and down buttons when there are more than fit.

Blocks # Block What it shows Title The product title, with the subtitle from the product's Subtitle field when Show subtitle is on. Rating Stars from a reviews app that fills Shopify's standard rating fields. Hidden when there are no ratings. Price Price, sale price, unit price and tax note, plus Shop Pay Installments when available. Variant picker Picker type : Pills or Dropdown . Show swatches uses the colors and images from Shopify's swatch settings. Sold-out combinations are marked. Purchase options One-time purchase and subscription plans from your subscription app (selling plans), with the saving shown. Note under each plan adds a short line under the plans. Products that can only be bought as a subscription start with the first plan selected. Supply How long one pack lasts and the price per day, from Units per day and the number of units in the variant (or Servings per package ). Buy buttons Add to cart, with Show quantity selector and Show dynamic checkout buttons . For gift cards, Show recipient form for gift cards lets customers send the card to someone else. Low stock "Only N left" when the selected variant's stock is at or below Show when stock is at or below . It updates when the variant changes, and is hidden for products whose inventory isn't tracked or that keep selling when out of stock. Pickup availability Local pickup status for the selected variant, from Settings > Locations . Complementary products A short list of products that go well together, chosen in the block, with quick add buttons. The product itself is left out. Collapsible row A heading and content: your own text, the product description or a page's content. Text A short line, for example a supplement disclaimer. Custom Liquid and app blocks Code or app blocks, for example reviews.
Section settings # Show breadcrumbs shows the path above the product, and Show sticky add to cart turns on the bar below.
Sticky add to cart # Show sticky add to cart shows a bar with the product, variant and add to cart button once the main button scrolls out of view.

Sections below the product # Related products : Shopify's automatic recommendations. Product comparison : see below. Complementary products section: products Shopify suggests as complements, set up in the Search & Discovery app. Nutrition table , Ingredient spotlight , Image comparison , FAQ , Image with text overlay : see Product content .

Product comparison # A table that compares up to four products, for example the formats of one supplement or products for different moments of the day. Products : choose up to four. With none chosen, a product page shows products from the product's first collection. On product pages, show the current product first : the product being viewed is the highlighted first column, marked "Viewing now". Show add to cart buttons : products with one variant get an Add button; products with options or subscriptions link to their page. One Row block per line of the table. Heading is the row's name and Shows what's in it: Shows What appears in the cell Price The price, with the compare-at price when a product with one variant is on sale, and "From" when variants have different prices. Availability In stock or Sold out. Product type, Vendor The product's type or vendor from Shopify admin. First matching tag The first of the row's Tags that the product has, for example capsules, softgels, drops shows the product's format. Yes / no for a tag A check mark when the product has the row's first tag (for example vegan ), a dash when it doesn't. Text when nothing matches replaces the dash, for example Any time . Tags are matched without regard to capital letters. On phones the table scrolls sideways with the row names kept in view. The section is hidden on gift cards and when there's only one product to show.

Product templates # Salvia includes three product templates: Default , featured (with nutrition table and ingredient spotlight) and powder (with a how-to-mix comparison). Choose a product's template in Shopify admin on the product page, under Theme template .
Content for each product The nutrition table, ingredient spotlight, product FAQ and similar sections hold content that's different for every product. There are two ways to set it up.

Option 1: a template per product # Best for stores with a handful of products. In the theme editor, open a product page and choose Create template from the template menu at the top. Base it on featured (or powder ) and name it after the product. Fill in the sections for that product: nutrients, claims, ingredients, FAQ. In Shopify admin, open the product and choose the new template under Theme template .

Option 2: dynamic sources (metafields) # Best for larger catalogues: one template shows each product's own content. In Settings > Custom data > Products , add metafield definitions, for example Serving size (single line text) or Benefits (list of single line text). Fill them in on each product. In the theme editor, select a setting (for example the nutrition table's Serving size or a Collapsible row's Content ) and click the Connect dynamic source icon next to it. Pick the metafield. Blocks are fixed per template, so for a table with a different number of rows per product, use option 1 or a rich text metafield in a Collapsible row.

Nutrition table # Heading : [product] is replaced by the product title. Outside a product page it's replaced by Name outside a product page . Serving size , a round image , column titles and a Note under the table . Nutrient blocks: name, amount and reference value in %. Values over 100% show a full bar; leave it empty to show a dash. Claim blocks: short checked lines beside the table. Only use health claims that are authorised where you sell. In the EU and UK, use the exact wording of the authorised claim, and only when the product contains enough of the nutrient.

Ingredient spotlight # A large image of the first ingredient with Ingredient blocks (image, name, text) and Fact blocks (label and value, for example Serving: 1 capsule ). Set the link to #Science to jump to the nutrition table.
Product FAQ # The FAQ section takes one Row block per question. Avoid questions that invite health promises, such as when results appear.
Image comparison # Before and after images with a slider, and steps beside them. Use two images with the same size and framing.
Collections and search Collection pages use two sections: Collection banner and Product grid . The search page uses Search results .

Collection banner # Breadcrumbs, the collection description and the collection image (set in Shopify admin on the collection). Image layout : Beside the title (keeps products near the top), Wide banner , or Full width, image's own shape (nothing cropped). Set a focal point on the image in admin to choose what stays in view. Collection shortcuts : a scrolling row of links to other collections.

Product grid # Products per page : 12, 24, 36 and 48 fill whole rows in two, three and four columns. Pagination : a Load more button or page numbers. Show grid size switcher lets customers switch between large cards (three columns on desktop, one on phones) and small cards (four on desktop, two on phones). Enable filtering with Horizontal or Sidebar layout, and Enable sorting . Card options: second image on hover, product type and quick view.

Filters # Salvia shows the filters you set up in Shopify's Search & Discovery app: availability, price, product type, vendor, tags, variant options (with swatches) and metafields. Filters update the products without reloading the page.
Quick view # The plus button on product cards opens a quick view with media, variants and add to cart. Products that need a selling plan show a link to choose a plan on the product page.
Collections list page # The page at /collections shows all your collections as tiles, with an optional description. Collections appear in the order Shopify returns them.
Search # Search shows products, articles and pages in tabs, with filters and sorting for products. With no results, it shows Popular searches and collections to try.
Cart Choose between a cart drawer and a cart page in Theme settings > Cart .

Cart drawer and cart page # Quantity buttons update the cart without reloading; quick clicks are combined into one update. If there isn't enough stock, the line shows the reason and the quantity goes back to what's available. Discounts, unit prices, selling plans and gift card recipients show on each line. Show order note adds a note field. Collection shows recommended products from a collection that aren't in the cart yet.

Free shipping progress # Set the threshold in Theme settings > Cart and turn on Show free shipping progress in the cart sections. It's hidden for visitors who shop in another currency, because the threshold is in your store currency.
Empty cart # When the cart is empty it shows a heading, text, a button, a menu of links (for example your collections) and an extra link, all set in the cart sections.
Blog and pages

Journal (blog) # Show the newest article large , Show topics (from article tags), excerpts, dates and reading time. On articles: featured image, date, reading time, author, share buttons and more articles. Tag an article with product:handle (for example product:daily-foundation ) to show up to three products under it. These tags are hidden from the topic list.

Pages # The Page section shows the page title, an optional eyebrow, intro, image and the page content, optionally on a card. Salvia includes templates for About, Ingredients, FAQ, Shipping and Contact pages: choose them when you create a page.

Contact page # The Contact form section has optional phone and order number fields and can show your store email. Add Fact blocks for response times or opening hours, and a Store location section for your address.
404 page # A message with a search field and a menu of links.
Password page # Shown while your store is password-protected. Add a logo (and a Logo for dark backgrounds ), image, heading and an optional email signup.
Gift card page # The page customers open from their gift card email: the balance, the code with a copy button, a QR code, an Apple Wallet button and a print button.
Languages and markets

Selling in several countries # Add countries and currencies in Settings > Markets . Turn on the country/region selector in the announcement bar or footer. Prices, including those calculated in the browser (routine totals, shop the look), use your store's money format for the visitor's currency.

Translating your store # Salvia's text is in English. Add languages in Settings > Languages and translate the theme's text and your content with Shopify's Translate & Adapt app. Text you type into sections is translated there too.
Things to check per market # The free shipping threshold is in your store currency and is hidden in other currencies. Health claims must be allowed in each country you sell to.
Accessibility and performance

Accessibility # Everything works with a keyboard, with a visible focus outline and a skip link to the content. Menus, the cart drawer, quick view and popups keep focus inside while open and return it when closed. Changes such as adding to the cart are announced to screen readers. Slideshows, announcements and videos can be paused, and don't move for visitors who prefer reduced motion. Default color schemes meet WCAG AA contrast. Check contrast when you change colors. Add alt text to your images in Shopify admin; decorative images are hidden from screen readers.

Performance # No frameworks: small scripts that load only for the sections on the page. Responsive images in the right size for each screen; images below the first screen load lazily. Videos and maps load only when they're needed. Apps add their own code. If your store slows down, check which apps load on the page.

Frequently asked questions How do I show a nutrition table for every product? See Product content : use a template per product, or connect the settings to metafields. How do I offer subscriptions? Install a subscription app, such as Shopify Subscriptions, and create selling plans. Salvia shows them in the Purchase options block without an app block. Why don't filters appear on my collection? Add filters in the Shopify Search & Discovery app, and check that Enable filtering is on in the Product grid section. Why doesn't the free shipping bar show? Set a threshold above 0 in Theme settings > Cart and turn on Show free shipping progress in the cart sections. It's hidden for visitors shopping in another currency. Why don't I see the country/region selector? It appears when your store sells in more than one country. Add countries in Settings > Markets. How do I add product reviews? Install a reviews app and add its app block to the product page. Apps that fill Shopify's standard rating fields also show stars through the Rating block. My logo disappears on a dark header. Add a light version under Logo for dark backgrounds in the Header (and Footer) section. Why don't Follow on Shop and dynamic checkout buttons appear? They need Shop Pay and the related payment methods to be turned on in your store.
Support We help with questions about Salvia's features and settings, and we fix bugs in the theme. We reply within two business days.

Before you write # Check the FAQ and the page of this guide about the feature you're using. If the problem started after you installed an app or edited code, try the same page in a fresh copy of Salvia from the Theme Store. If it works there, the app or the code change is the likely cause.

What support includes # Help with the theme's settings, sections and features. Fixes for bugs in the theme. Support doesn't include custom design or code changes, problems caused by third-party apps or edited theme code, or setting up your store's products and content. For these, we recommend a Shopify Partner .

Contact form # Name Email Store URL Your myshopify.com address, for example your-store.myshopify.com Theme version Shown under the theme name in Online Store > Themes Topic Choose a topic Question about a setting or feature Something isn't working Feedback or feature request Other How can we help? Describe what you expected and what happened instead, and the page where it happens. Screenshot or file (optional) Send request
Thanks, we've got your request We'll reply by email within two business days. A copy of your request is on its way to your inbox. Back to the documentation
